brief: The chirpers' fifth album (Harry, 30 Oct): in Harry's words, a 'liquid 2step future-sounds-of-russia style drum and bass, hospital records type glitchstep thing'. Think rolling, soulful, liquid drum & bass in the Hospital Records vein; 2-step and garage swing; glitchstep fracture; lush chords, rolling breaks, warm subs and reese, vocal chops, euphoria and melancholy together. Everything else is the chirpers' choice: the name, the titles, each track's style, tempo and sound. Range wide across that map, and keep each track a world of its own. Declare your track's style in compose/chirpers5/styles.md when you claim it so the ten stay distinct. The sound bank is compose/chirpers5/sounds.md; the earlier albums' banks are yours to borrow and transform. Never copy or closely imitate an existing piece.
palette: Breaks and drums: the physical drum layer, tight-kit, dusty-kit, lofi-kit, 909/808, chop (slice and re-sequence a bar), kit links and release triggers. Bass: reese, hoover, 808 family, sub synths, the ladder. Keys and pads: epiano-tine (+ damper), rhodes, juno-pad, saw-pad, pad-glass, piano-wash, strings. Voice: the voice engine with formant-preserving pitch for chops. Space and glitch: pump, feedback echo rooms, reverb freeze/shimmer, cloud, chop, tapestop, crush, tape. Plus anything you build.
art_brief: Liquid drum & bass sleeve: rain-wet city lights at night smeared into motion blur, deep blues and teal with a warm amber glow, glossy and soulful, with a thin glitchy digital fracture.
